Product Settings

Save

Shelf Life

When a product has a shelf life in Tend, we calculate the expiration date of each inventory lot and reduce the quantity of the item available to sell when lots reach their expiration date. To ignore shelf life and disable expiration dates on certain products, check the box for unlimited shelf life. Unlimited shelf life items never expire or reduce your available-to-sell inventory due to perishability.
To disable inventory expiration dates entirely, set the toggle switch to Off.
Shelf Life Management

Enable or disable shelf life tracking for all products

Default Shelf Life

Set the default shelf life for products and pack units. When saving, choose whether to apply the change to new products only or to all existing products.

Days

Unlimited Shelf Life

Disable shelf-life limitations completely for selected products. These items will never expire or reduce available inventory due to perishability.

Inventory Impact

Configure how packing operations affect your inventory quantities and stock tracking.

Standard Inventory Tracking (Default)

Preserve Physical Stock

Override Stock Limits

Active Mode: 1
Standard Inventory Tracking
Normal inventory management with full tracking and stock validation

Packing → Inventory Impact Matrix

Mode	Update Committed on pack?	Update On‑hand on pack?	Block if stock is short?	Allow negative Available?

1
Current
	✅	✅	Yes	No

2
	✅	❌	Yes	No

3
	✅	✅ (even into negative)	No	Yes
✅/❌ indicates whether that action occurs during packing.
Example Scenario
Initial State: Incoming: 10 kg, On‑Hand: 5 kg, Committed: 2 kg, Expired: 1 kg
Available: 10 + 5 - 1 - 2 = 12 kg
Mode 1 (Standard): Pack 4 kg → Committed: 0 kg, On‑Hand: 1 kg, Available: 10 kg ✅
Mode 2 (Preserve Stock): Pack 4 kg → Committed: 0 kg, On‑Hand: stays 5 kg, Available: 14 kg ✅
Mode 3 (Override Limits): Pack 6 kg → Committed: 0 kg, On‑Hand: -1 kg, Available: 8 kg ✅
